faq.question1: Is the Gratis plan really Gratis Selamanya?
faq.answer1: Yes! Our Truly Gratis plan includes 1 human agent untuk life dengan Tidak Terbatas conversations, chat history, and contacts. Plus, you get 1 AI agent dengan 100 lifetime AI replies to try our AI Fitur. No credit card required, no hidden fees.
faq.question2: What's the difference between Bulanan dan yearly billing?

faq.question3: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?
faq.answer3: Absolutely! You can change your plan at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately, and downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing cycle.
faq.question4: What happens if I exceed my AI reply limit on the Gratis plan?
faq.answer4: The Gratis plan includes 100 lifetime AI replies. Once you reach this limit, you'll need to upgrade to Premium untuk Tidak Terbatas AI responses. Your human agent functionality remains Tidak Terbatas on all plans.
faq.question5: How does the Premium plan Harga work?
faq.answer5: Premium has two components: a license fee ($29.99/month or $299/year) plus usage-based Harga. Usage includes AI responses starting at $0.006 each (ChatGPT-4o mini) and Panggilan Suara at $0.12/minute. Additional human users cost $10/month each, and extra workspaces cost $15/month each.
faq.question6: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.answer6: You own your data. You can export all your chat history, contacts, and knowledge base content at any time, even on the Gratis plan. We believe in data freedom dan transparency.
faq.question7: Do you offer custom Harga untuk large enterprises?

faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SeaVoice AI dan how it can transform your business communications

q1.question: How does SeaVoice differ from a traditional chatbot?
q1.answer: SeaVoice provides real-time voice conversations dengan Lanjutan AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, and deliver human-like responses over the phone. Unlike text-based chatbots, SeaVoice handles actual Panggilan Suara dengan natural speech patterns.

q2.question: How long does it take to set up?
q2.answer: Pengaturan typically takes less than 20 minutes. You can train your voice agent, connect your phone system, set up call rules, and go live in one session.

q3.question: Can callers tell they're speaking dengan an AI?
q3.answer: Our Lanjutan voice technology creates very human-like conversations. While some callers may notice, most find the experience natural dan helpful. You can also customize the AI to introduce itself as an AI assistant if preferred.

q4.question: What happens if SeaVoice can't answer a question?
q4.answer: SeaVoice is designed to handle escalations gracefully. It can transfer calls to human agents, take messages, schedule callbacks, or direct callers to appropriate resources based on your configured rules.

q5.question: How does Harga work?
q5.answer: We offer transparent per-minute Harga. Premium plans include base minutes dengan additional usage billed per minute. Enterprise plans are customized based on volume dan specific needs.

q6.question: Can I customize the AI's voice?
q6.answer: Yes! You can choose from multiple voice options, adjust tone dan speaking style, and even clone custom voices untuk Enterprise plans. The AI can be trained to match your brand's communication style.

q7.question: Is SeaVoice multilingual?
q7.answer: Yes, SeaVoice supports conversations in over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, and Japanese.

q8.question: What Industri benefit most from SeaVoice?
q8.answer: SeaVoice works well across Industri including Kesehatan, Real Estat, Perhotelan, Layanan Keuangan, E-commerce, Profesional services, and any business that handles high call volumes or needs 24/7 availability.

q9.question: Can SeaVoice handle emergency calls?
q9.answer: While SeaVoice can handle urgent inquiries dan escalate appropriately, we recommend maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaVoice can be configured to immediately transfer emergency-related calls to human operators.

q10.question: Can SeaVoice detect spam calls?
q10.answer: Yes, SeaVoice includes built-in spam detection that can identify dan filter suspicious calls, protecting your business from unwanted interruptions while ensuring legitimate calls get through.

q11.question: How do I Mulai?
q11.answer: Memulai is easy! Jadwalkan Demo to see SeaVoice in action, then our team will help you set up your voice agent, integrate dengan your phone system, and configure it untuk your specific needs. Most customers are up dan running within a day.
